topic: Template Class Specialization for Type Traits
explanation: In modern C++, template specialization and SFINAE (Substitution Failure Is Not An Error) are powerful techniques that enable compile-time type introspection and conditional compilation. They allow developers to write generic code that adapts to different types or conditions, improving code flexibility, safety, and efficiency. These features are essential for creating highly generic libraries, such as the Standard Template Library (STL), and for implementing type traits, enable_if conditions, and optimized algorithms.
keywords: Type Traits, Template Class Specialization, SFINAE, Compile-time Introspection
